text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Greek Cypriot press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these reports and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- The United States is retreating from the Cyprus problem, U.S. President Bill Clinton says.
- Foreign Secretary Malcom Rifkind's comments about the risk of war between Greece and Turkey did not refer to Cyprus, the British Foreign Office said.
- Cyprus accepted the rules set by former U.N. Secretary- General Boutros Boutros Ghali on the issue of missing persons.
- Doors are opening to attract Greek capital to the Cyprus Stock Exchange.
